projects.name: AI Multilingual Tutor-Bot with NLP
projects.description:
Developed a multilingual AI tutor using GPT, MarianMT, DistilBERT, RoBERTa, and Python, enabling translation, autocomplete, sentiment, and emotion analysis.
Benchmarked NLP performance on 3,000 French sentences using SequenceMatcher, achieving an 87.29% similarity score while optimizing inference efficiency.

projects.name: ESP32 Biometric Login System
projects.description:
Built a biometric authentication platform using ESP32, Flask, JWT, Socket.IO, and Python, enabling secure real-time communication between embedded hardware and a web application.
Implemented JWT-based session management with automated token cleanup and multi-step verification, strengthening authentication security and improving application reliability.
